weather_line: Ridgeline clear by midmorning · fog cooperating · something watching from the treeline, pleasantly

stories.headline: Second Witness Confirms Ridgeline Creature; Describes It as 'Thoughtful'; Survey Office Upgrades File to Provisional Amber
body: The Magical Creature Survey Office confirmed Friday that a second independent witness has observed the unclassified creature on the ridgeline above the Red River hollows, this time at half-past six in the morning as the fog was lifting from the lower gorge in what meteorologists described as 'its best performance of the season so far.'

The second witness — a seventh-year Hogwarts student completing a field naturalist placement — described the creature as 'fox-adjacent, copper-coloured, sitting very upright, watching the mist as though it had a specific opinion about how it should dissipate.' She added that it glanced at her once, apparently decided she was not the person it was waiting for, and returned its attention to the valley below.

Survey Office Senior Analyst Perdita Marsh upgraded the file from Preliminary White to Provisional Amber on the grounds that 'any creature with opinions about fog is operating above the baseline threshold for magical sentience.' The creature has not descended. The ridgeline reports it is not inconvenienced by this arrangement.

stories.headline: Friday Client Arrives With Three Concerns; Departs With One; Christine Settled the Other Two Before He Finished His Sentence
stories.byline: By our Diagon Alley banking correspondent
body: A client presenting to the Gringotts Senior Liaison desk at nine forty-five Friday morning arrived in possession of three distinct and separately documented concerns regarding his account, the goblin interest schedule, and what he described as 'a discrepancy that may or may not be a discrepancy pending clarification of what counts as a discrepancy.'

He was in the building for twenty-two minutes. He departed with one concern, which Christine had already flagged for review on his behalf the previous afternoon, and which will be resolved by Tuesday. The other two, he acknowledged upon reflection, had not been concerns. He is not sure how that happened. He thanked her twice.
Three goblins, observing from behind the teller columns, were reported to have exchanged a look of professional approval. This is the third such look recorded this week. The ledger is current.

stories.headline: Friday Evening Arrives on Schedule; Steve Consults the Jeep; the Jeep Conveys No Outstanding Objections
body: Friday evening was formally welcomed into the household at approximately five past six, when Steve performed the customary end-of-week walk-around of the enchanted Jeep, checked the running lights, noted the tyre pressure with the focused expression of a man who takes tyre pressure seriously on a personal level, and received from the vehicle what sources describe as 'a general sense of goodwill and no new complaints.'

The Jeep, which forgives him nightly, was described as being in excellent spirits and 'entirely prepared for whatever the weekend proposes.' Steve has not yet told the Jeep what the weekend proposes. The Jeep is patient. It has been patient before.

stories.headline: Ministry's 'Wholesome, Misc.' Registry Now Occupies Its Own Volume; Senior Archivist Quoyne Requests a Bigger Shelf
body: The Department of Record and Registry confirmed Friday that the 'Wholesome, Miscellaneous' filing category — opened in August as a catchall subcategory of Resolved Matters — has expanded sufficiently to require its own bound volume, Volume II having been completed with the Briefcase Resolution earlier this week.

Senior Archivist Quoyne, who has been at peace since Thursday, submitted a facilities requisition for an additional twelve inches of shelf space and a label holder 'of the self-adhesive variety, which holds.' He was asked whether he expected Wholesome, Misc. to continue generating volume at its current rate. He said he had no way of knowing, but that in his experience some files keep finding reasons to fill themselves, and that this is not the worst problem a registry can have.
Volume III has been pre-labelled and is waiting on the blotter. The blotter is, sources note, no longer warm. This is simply how it is now.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Conducted a thorough inspection of the biscuit tin's perimeter at 3:15 a.m. and again at 3:18 a.m. — a routine audit, she would explain if asked, which she will not be, having left no evidence of the audit whatsoever.

Ellie: Discovered this morning that the window reflects something that looks remarkably like Ellie, and spent a warm and companionable quarter-hour with it before losing track of the thread entirely and going to find a sunny spot, which was in a different room, which was also fine.

Jersey: Assessed all available laps at six-fifteen and selected Christine's on the grounds of warmth, proximity, and what he has privately categorised as 'an excellent Friday lap, which is its own distinct category.'
founding_editor_note: Twelve inches of shelf space is a reasonable request. I'd have asked for eighteen and negotiated down. That's how you get sixteen. — D.

in_brief.sport: Friday Recreational Lifting League announces the weekend is, technically, a rest day — though Christine's definition of 'rest' continues to be reviewed by the relevant committee.
in_brief.forecast: Clear skies over the ridgeline through Saturday morning; fog in the hollows holding steady at 'atmospheric and cooperative'; the creature watching from the treeline, unbothered, doing exactly what it came to do.

storyline_updates.title: The Autumn Creature Survey
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: A second witness — a Hogwarts field naturalist student — confirmed the creature on the ridgeline at half-past six Friday morning. Copper-coloured, fox-adjacent, sitting upright, watching the fog dissipate 'with opinions.' It glanced at the witness, determined she was not the person it was waiting for, and returned its gaze to the valley. Survey file upgraded to Provisional Amber. The creature has still not descended. Day 3 should develop what — or who — the creature appears to be waiting for, perhaps with a detail connecting it to Christine, Steve, or the Jeep trail, or a Survey Office theory about its classification that is warmly, specifically wrong.
